title: Return-to-Brand Mileage Credit on Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease Excess Mileage
content:
**Loyalty bulletin — return-to-brand mileage credit, Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease**

**Clause.** The return-to-brand mileage credit is 3000 miles (the new-vehicle return-to-brand miles) when the customer holds an active Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract or an active Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract whose contract date falls within 90 calendar days before or after the turn-in date; it is 1500 miles (the pre-owned return-to-brand miles) when no such contract exists but the customer holds an active Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract whose contract date falls within that window and that shows days past due of 0; otherwise there is no return-to-brand mileage credit. The credited miles are added to the mileage allowance before the miles driven are compared with it.

**Reading the contracts.** Where the customer's records for one of these products list more than one active contract, the first active contract listed is the one read. The days between the turn-in date and a contract date are counted in calendar days in either direction, the later date counted and the earlier one not; 90 days away is within the window, 91 is not.

| Active new-vehicle retail or balloon contract (first listed) | Active pre-owned retail contract (first listed) | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| dated 45 days after turn-in | — | 3000 miles |
| dated 90 days before turn-in, 20 days past due | — | 3000 miles (no days-past-due condition for new-vehicle or balloon) |
| dated 91 days before turn-in | dated 30 days after, 0 days past due | 1500 miles |
| none | dated 30 days after, 4 days past due | none |
| none | dated 120 days before, 0 days past due | none |

**Hypothetical illustration**: miles driven 39800 against an allowance of 36000; a Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract dated 20 days after the turn-in, current, raises the allowance to 37500 for the comparison, leaving 2300 miles over.
